Local Jewelry Leads Atlanta

CaratBase sends local jewelry leads in Atlanta to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers, from people looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or purchase an engagement ring. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

How It Works

  • Accept what fits – You pay only for the leads you accept.
  • No monthly minimum – The only recurring cost is the optional Pro widget.

What You Get

  • First three leads free
  • Pay-per-lead pricing – $40 for each accepted lead.
  • Optional Pro website widget – $12/month.
  • Local focus – Atlanta first.

FAQ

Does CaratBase cover local jewelry leads in Atlanta? Yes. CaratBase is starting in Atlanta.

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

Do I need a long-term contract? No. Leads are priced per accepted lead, with no monthly minimum aside from the optional Pro widget.
